title: A day at the café
subtitle: Elif's job interview — do, does, don't, doesn't
canDo: I can ask questions: Do you…? Does she…?
I can say what I don't do: I don't, she doesn't.
I can write about my day.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: "My day" yazısını ödev verin (Copy my text ile size göndersinler).
does'tan sonra fiil -s almaz (She doesn't works ✗). Bunu 3.3'teki -s kuralıyla karşılaştırarak gösterin.
Arap öğrencilere: Do / Does soru başında "هل"in işini görür. Türk öğrencilere: "mi" soru ekinin yerine Do / Does başa gelir.
Rol yapma: Öğrencilerden biri Sam, biri iş arayan olsun; ilandaki sorularla kısa bir mülakat yapsınlar.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Biscuit's day
paragraphs: He's five, and he's small and brown.
Biscuit doesn't work, but he comes to the café every day.
In the morning, he sleeps under a table.
He doesn't drink coffee, and he doesn't eat cookies.
Well … Sam says, “No cookies for Biscuit!”

sections.title: Grammar: do / does, don't / doesn't
rules: After does / doesn't: no -s! She **doesn't work**. **Does** she **work**?
Questions: **Do / Does** + person + verb: **Does** Omar **work** at night?
With am / is / are, don't use do: **Are** you a student? (not “Do you are…”)
examples: Do you speak Turkish? — Yes, I do.
Does Sam have a dog? — Yes, he does.

support.tr: Geniş zamanda olumsuz ve soru için yardımcı fiil kullanılır: do / does. Olumsuz: I don't work = Çalışmam. Soru: Do you work? = Çalışır mısın? he / she / it ile does gelir ve fiildeki -s kaybolur: She doesn't work, Does she work? Be fiiliyle (am / is / are) do kullanılmaz: Are you a student?
support.ar: في النفي والسؤال بالمضارع البسيط نستخدم do / does. النفي: I don't work = لا أعمل. السؤال: Do you work? = هل تعمل؟ — هنا تقوم Do بدور «هل». مع he / she / it نستخدم does ويعود الفعل بدون s: She doesn't work، Does she work? وتذكّر: لا نستخدم do مع am / is / are.

tr.note: Olumsuzda sadece not yetmez, don't / doesn't gerekir. does'tan sonra fiile -s ekleme.

ar.note: لا تبدأ السؤال بالفعل مباشرةً، ولا تستخدم does مع I / you.

sections.title: Write: My day

model.heading: My day — Elif
text: I have a big breakfast, and I walk to school.
Class starts at nine and finishes at twelve.
On Saturdays and Sundays, I work at Sam's café.
And you? Do you work on weekends?

sections.prompt: Write about your day (6 sentences). Use one sentence with don't and one question. Send your text to your teacher.

support.tr: Gününü anlat (6 cümle). Bir cümlede don't, bir cümlede soru kullan. Metnini öğretmenine gönder.
support.ar: اكتب عن يومك (6 جمل). استخدم don't في جملة، واكتب سؤالًا واحدًا. أرسل نصّك إلى معلّمك.

checklist: I use don't or doesn't one time.
I write one question with Do or Does.
After doesn't, the verb has no -s.
